roadmap.title: Story, in order
roadmap.blurb: Play the story missions in order. The chapter trophies and the key mission trophies fall out as you go; nothing here needs a detour.

roadmap.title: Contacts and strangers
roadmap.blurb: Finish each contact's final mission and the stranger strands. Bret's unique animal is the one to watch — it is the only missable trophy in this stage.

roadmap.title: Hidden moments
roadmap.blurb: These are the hidden trophies: one-off moments the game does not advertise. They happen during the story and in free roam — watch for them as they come, and turn spoilers on if you want them listed.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.blurb: Try every activity, then master them: gold the shooting range, win the drone races and the races, beat Cal at fishing, and pile up stunts and challenges.

roadmap.title: Explore and collect
roadmap.blurb: See all of Leonida and pick it clean: every area, every meditation spot, every vehicle, the card sets, the WAiNK It spots, the garages, and the money to launder and spend.

roadmap.title: Heists, combat and 100%
roadmap.blurb: The hard combat and the big robberies, then the last gold: 100% completion. The platinum pops the moment the last of the other 54 does.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of the other 54. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then contacts and strangers, then activities, exploration and heists, and finish with 100% completion. Nothing here needs a separate trick — it unlocks the moment the last of the other 54 pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission; play it through to the end and the trophy pops when it completes. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — it is the first story beat, and it unlocks the rest of the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its missions in order. Story missions unlock one after another, so keep following the mission markers; the trophy pops at the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 the same way: play its missions in order until the chapter closes. The trophy is unmissable as long as you keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Same rule as the other chapters: follow the story missions in order until the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Same rule: play its missions in order until the chapter closes and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the last story mission; finish it and the gold pops. It is the end of the story spine, so every chapter trophy comes before it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the story reaches it; play it through to the end. A story mission trophy — unmissable, it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission: it appears in the story order, and the trophy pops when the heist is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Same as the other story missions: play it through when the story offers it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission trophy — play it through when it unlocks.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport; play it through when the story offers it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission trophy — play it through when it unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long grind after the story: missions, activities, collectibles and exploration all count toward the percentage. Use the in-game stats to see what is left, and clear the remaining categories one by one. It is the last gold before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime; they add up across all driving, so drive fast and take jumps whenever you travel. There is no single spot required — 250 accumulates naturally if you drive aggressively, and faster if you deliberately chain jumps.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks 9 activity types — racing, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation, drone races, stunts and more. Open the activities and try one of each; the trophy pops when the last type is tried. Nothing here is missable — activities stay open.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. PlayStation tracks 42 challenges. Each challenge has a gold score threshold; aim steadily, learn the target pattern, and replay a challenge until the gold medal lands. You can retry any challenge as often as you like, so work through them one at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations. Each race is a drone course through gates; learn the course, cut corners where the gates allow, and win once per location. Races can be retried, so a lost race costs nothing but time.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. These are the game's driving races; win 20 distinct events, not the same race 20 times. Pick races that suit your car, and retry any you lose.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head against Cal; cast where the fish are, keep the tension steady, and reel in cleanly. You can challenge Cal again if you lose, so treat the first try as practice.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine, start a game and play it to its end. Any arcade game counts; pick the shortest one if you just want the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand ends with a final mission; play his missions in order until it appears, then finish it. Contact finales unlock as you progress their strands.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same as Andy: play Kenton's strand to its final mission and finish it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Same as the other contact finales: play Billy's strand to its end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers are the side characters marked in the world; each has a short strand of missions. Do 8 full strands. They unlock as you explore, so keep an eye out for stranger markers while travelling.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Same as the other contact finales: play Randy's strand to its end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Same as the other contact finales: play Tyrone's strand to its end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. PlayStation tracks 18 meditation spots. Meditation spots are quiet places in the world; visit each one and meditate there. They are spread across the map, so this pairs well with exploring every area.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret offers a hunt for a single unique animal. MISSABLE — the animal is unique, so take the hunt when Bret offers it and do not kill the animal outside the hunt. Track it, take the shot cleanly, and the trophy pops when the hunt completes.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; each set needs its cards found. Collect cards as you explore, and track which sets are complete — 3 full sets earns the silver.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-world photo and tagging activity; use it at 100 different locations. This is a grind best done while exploring — tag spots as you pass them rather than hunting all 100 at once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; finish any 50. They accumulate across activities, so play broadly and the count climbs.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. Use alleys and interiors to break sight; the trophy pops when the heat is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob a shop, then immediately rob a second and a third, keeping your wanted level the whole time. Plan a route with three shops close together, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count when you first find and drive them; 100 distinct vehicles. Drive everything you see — the count climbs as you explore, and it pairs with the exploration trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode; trigger it in a fight with at least 5 enemies, and down all 5 before it ends. Pick a fight with a group, and line up shots while time is slowed.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the airport; leave it in a way that is not a scheduled flight — take an aircraft yourself and depart on your own terms. It is a hidden trophy, so the game does not advertise it; try departing the airport by an aircraft you take yourself.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks; this trophy is about a Rhino encounter. Expect a Rhino in the world or in a mission; engage it on your terms, with heavy weapons or a fast escape. It is hidden, so it pops when the Rhino moment happens.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Enter a jewelry store, take the goods and leave without any detection. Move quietly, avoid cameras and guards, and do not raise an alarm — if you are spotted, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are the big heists; complete 5 and escape each time. Plan the escape route before you go in, and expect a wanted level on the way out.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and escape. Trucks travel set routes; intercept one, crack it, and get clear before the response arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PlayStation tracks 52 areas. Visit every named area of the map; the trophy pops when the last one is discovered. This pairs with meditation spots, vehicles and card hunting — explore thoroughly rather than fast-travelling everywhere.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations; rob one operation per gang. Learn which operations belong to which gang, and work through all 9.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a bar with a view, and enjoy it. A quiet moment trophy — no combat, just the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a scripted-style moment: drive out of a vehicle showroom by smashing through it. It is hidden, so it pops when the moment happens in the story or in free roam.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl. Follow through on the lane — a relaxed activity trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a partnership moment — a story beat with your partner that lands with the public. MISSABLE — it is tied to a specific partnership moment, so play the story beats with your partner when they come and do not skip them.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks choices to a count of 500. Story choices are one-time — each choice you make counts, and the counter only moves when you choose. MISSABLE — a playthrough has a finite set of choices, so do not rush past choice moments; keep choosing as the story offers them.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This is about succeeding on a retry — fail an attempt, then succeed on the second try. If a challenge or event beats you once, go straight back and try again; the trophy is about the comeback.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange, one-off event in the world. MISSABLE — it is a rare random event, so it is easy to pass without triggering it. Keep an eye out for odd encounters while exploring, especially in remote places.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, use a melee attack to knock someone down. Line up a slow pass beside a pedestrian and swing as you go by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the illicit cash; launder them through your contacts to turn them into clean money. $250,000 laundered in total earns it — launder steadily as you earn marked bills.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops — clothes, food, gear, anything. It accumulates across all purchases, so normal spending counts toward it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties. Buy every garage; they give you storage and count toward the trophy. Save up and buy them as they become available.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles you find. Register 10 different vehicles — drive a vehicle, open the app and register it.
